sample_unit: FDA drug labels (128,906 entities extracted); MIMIC-CXR reports also evaluated

links.outcome: Whether conformal calibration of LLM extraction confidence achieves target coverage with acceptable rejection rates
links.effect: Conformal prediction reached at least 90% target coverage in both FDA label and radiology settings, with 9-13% rejection rates; models were underconfident on FDA labels (tau about 0.06) and overconfident on radiology (tau up to 0.99).
links.quote: Despite this heterogeneity, conformal prediction achieves target coverage ($\geq 90\%$) in both settings with manageable rejection rates (9--13\%).

unlisted_practices: Domain-specific conformal prediction calibration with finite-sample coverage guarantees for LLM medical entity extraction, with rejection of low-confidence extractions

screen.practice: conformal prediction calibration thresholds for LLM output rejection
screen.reason: Evaluates conformal prediction as a risk-controlling deployment practice/safeguard for LLM clinical entity extraction across two medical datasets to guarantee coverage.

primary.practice: conformal prediction for risk-controlled entity extraction
